parameters.content: **Escalation Radar** – This workflow ranks every open service ticket by risk and finds faults that many customers are reporting. It receives a car model (or "All") and how many tickets to list, then reads the live Service Tickets Google Sheet fresh on every run, turns it into one row per ticket, and applies five rules to give each open ticket a risk score from 0 to 100: days open, repeat workshop visits, safety, whether the fault is repeated across customers, and fleet or corporate customers. A score of 60 or more means escalate today, 35–59 means watch. It also groups tickets about the same fault, such as the DCT gearbox judder reported 16 times across 3 models in 8 cities. To use new data, change the sheet link in the HTTP Request node. Website: [Customer Voice Hub](https://claude.ai/artifact/5zcaETuNP1thw1ksJPTWLv)
